description.value: HI Whistler is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Whistler, BC, one of Canada's most celebrated mountain resort communities and a hub for trail cycling, ski touring, and the Sea-to-Sky corridor. As part of the HI Canada network, it offers budget-friendly shared accommodation appealing to independent travellers and adventure seekers. Touring cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky route or exploring Whistler's extensive trail system would find it a practical, centrally located base.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched for https://www.hihostels.ca/whistler consists almost entirely of navigation menus listing HI Canada hostels across the country; no Whistler-specific amenity details (bike storage, laundry, tools, breakfast, etc.) are present in the retrieved text. OSM confirms an active hostel at 1035 Legacy Way with internet_access=wlan, but per instructions OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so Wi-Fi is left null. The hostel is clearly listed as active on the HI Canada site and the URL matches the OSM tag, so contact_confirmed.website is set to true; phone and address cannot be cross-checked from the retrieved content.
